name: Swift
description: Builds Flow through quick active Essence use and rewards evasive, mobile pressure.

focuses.name: Phantom Step
focuses.description: Quickstep lasts 2 seconds longer, removes slows/roots, and prevents the first crowd control effect applied to you during Quickstep.

focuses.name: Flurry State
focuses.description: Quickstep empowers your next 3 Essence abilities instead of 1. Each receives 60% of the Quickstep potency bonus. Quickstep Action Speed bonus increased from 10% to 15%.

focuses.name: Assassinate Timing
focuses.description: During Quickstep, your first Essence effect against a target below 35% Health gains +18% Effect Potency. Healing/barrier effects on allies below 35% Health also gain +18%. If the effect does not defeat an enemy or prevent an ally from dropping lower, only half the bonus applies.

coreMechanic: Gain Flow from active Essence abilities. At 100 Flow, empower the next active effect.

skillTreeNodes.name: Untouchable Rhythm
skillTreeNodes.description: Dodging, parrying, avoiding, or being missed grants +4 additional Flow. After avoiding damage, your next Essence ability costs 10% less resource.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities.
tradeoffs: Advanced cooldowns, target caps, and PvP coefficients can be tuned per node.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.

skillTreeNodes.name: Split Action
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: TimingConversion. Eligible Essence abilities with a cooldown of 12+ seconds may split into two activations. The first activation resolves at 65% Effect Potency. The second resolves 2 seconds later at 45% Effect Potency if the target is still valid. Hard crowd control effects do not reapply; instead they gain 20% duration on the first activation. Resource cost +5%. 12 second internal cooldown.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching TimingConversion.
tradeoffs: Conversion uses a +5% resource cost safety tradeoff and PvP coefficient until explicit balance values are authored.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.
True damage unless the ability explicitly allows conversion.

skillTreeNodes.name: Chain Tempo
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: TimingConversion + ResourceConversion. Using two different Essence effect categories within 5 seconds gives the second ability the Quick tag. Quick abilities recover 10% cooldown faster and cost 5% less resource. If the same effect category is repeated, the second ability gains only half benefit.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching TimingConversion, ResourceConversion.
tradeoffs: Conversion uses a +5% resource cost safety tradeoff and PvP coefficient until explicit balance values are authored.

skillTreeNodes.name: Evasive Channel
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: DefensiveConversion + TimingConversion. After you dodge, parry, avoid, or activate Quickstep, your next cast, channel, summon, aura, or persistent Essence ability within 5 seconds becomes Evasive. Evasive abilities are 50% harder to interrupt, have 10% shorter cast/channel time, and grant 4% damage reduction for 3 seconds after resolving.
